source.title: Desert sand - Dune atmosphere
source.author: Vrymaa
source.notes: 48 kHz mono, 128 s: wind-blown sand flowing down a dune. Its first 23 s is one flow, swelling in over 2 s, steady from about 2 to 19.5 s across the whole range (the flow's rumble to the grains' hiss), fading out by 22.5 s. Six slices of the steady part, with soft fades so the bursts a dust storm plays from spots around the player blend together. The old file was one generated 2 s burst, mostly under 150 Hz; the level matches its loudness (-40 LUFS), not its RMS, which its rumble made up.
